acip: KHA CIG NA RE, YOD PA DANG MED PA GNYIS CHOS CAN, THA DAD CING GZHI MTHUN MI SRID PA YIN PAR THAL, 'GAL BA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: kha cig na re, yod pa dang med pa gnyis chos can, tha dad cing gzhi mthun mi srid pa yin par thal, 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir
english: Suppose someone comes to make the following claim: Let's consider the pair of existence and non-existence. It must be the case that they can be separate, and that there is no possible combination of the two. Why do you say that? Because they are contradictory.
